relevant_prelims_pyqs.question_text: Under which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India has the Supreme Court of India placed the Right to Privacy? [2024]
relevant_prelims_pyqs.source_pdf: X-Factor Prelims- Indian Polity for Pre'2027.pdf
relevant_prelims_pyqs.markdown_formatted:
**Q2 (2024)**: Under which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India has the Supreme Court of India placed the Right to Privacy? [2024]
- (a) Article 15
- (b) Article 16
- (c) Article 19
- (d) Article 21
- **Answer**: `(d)` ([View Source Page 47](pages/prelims/prelims_page_047.pdf))
